items.description: An unknown threat actor has infected 953 online stores, most of them running Magento, as part of a long-running campaign active since July 2025. items.title: OpenBSD 8.0 Released With Major Security Hardening and Post-Quantum SSH Support
items.description: OpenBSD 8.0 has been released with security fixes across its kernel, network services, firewall, and update tools, alongside experimental post-quantum SSH signature support.
